en.name: Sixtus II
en.summary: A pope martyred along with several of his deacons, including Lawrence, during the persecution ordered by the emperor Valerian.
en.body: Sixtus II's brief reign coincided with a fresh wave of persecution under the emperor Valerian, whose edicts specifically targeted Christian clergy. Sixtus was seized and executed while presiding at a gathering in one of Rome's catacombs, along with several of his deacons; his deacon Lawrence, according to strong early tradition, was martyred separately just days later after famously offering the poor of Rome as the true "treasures of the church" when ordered to surrender church wealth. Sixtus's reign also saw a partial healing of the earlier rift with the North African church over the rebaptism dispute.
